rationale_summary: The document's eight principles foreground rights-based concerns—privacy, fairness, non-discrimination, informed consent, and human dignity—as the primary justification for AI governance. While innovation and social harmony are also present, the explicit articulation of individual rights (知情权、选择权), prohibition of bias and discrimination, and data protection norms make fundamental rights the dominant frame.

evidence_spans.quote: 尊重和保护个人隐私，充分保障个人的知情权和选择权
促进公平公正，保障利益相关者的权益，促进机会均等……消除偏见和歧视
以保障社会安全、尊重人类权益为前提，避免误用，禁止滥用、恶用
对未来更高级人工智能的潜在风险持续开展研究和预判，确保人工智能始终朝着有利于人类的方向发展
